technique_name: Compare and contrast IPv4 and IPv6.
description: IPv4 and IPv6 are the two most commonly used protocols for Internet-based communication. IPv4 is the fourth version of the Internet Protocol and has a 32-bit address space, allowing for roughly 4.3 billion unique IP addresses. IPv6, on the other hand, is the sixth version of the Internet Protocol and features a 128-bit address space, allowing for far more potential connections.
